name: smwsprites-yi-wild-ptooie-non-dynamic-v1
title: YI Wild Ptooie (non-dynamic) v1.1
description:
The wild piranha plant from SMW2:YI which spits needlenoses. The projectile is included.

This sprite was part of smkdan's YI Pack 3, and was resubmitted separately after the remoderation for ease of search and to fit current standards.

v1.1
-----
Fixed a bug with SA1, RAM that checks if yellow needle is in yoshi's mouth wasn't using pixi's define, it was using the plain RAM which doesn't work on sa-1.
Minor fix, still a fix.
